detail: Executor-derived, recorded 2026-09-02 during the P2 transcription of the tactic-mainqa-* queue; enters deferred pending author ratification. The implicit-criteria shim's liquidation condition requires 'the transcribed set dispositioned through the deferred queue', but the two halves do not meet: deferredQueue (packages/intentionsutil/src/consolidation.ts) collects only (decision: deferred, ...) stamps found in node clarifications and bodies, and never reads authority: deferred entries in attributes.criteria. The 22 criteria this transcription appended to strategy-graph-native-dispatch, strategy-token-economy and strategy-graph-drives-dispatch are therefore invisible to that deriver, so their ratification path cannot be tracked by the queue the liquidation condition names. Two candidate resolutions for author review: (a) grow deferredQueue a criteria arm that emits one queue item per authority: deferred criterion in a node's effective criteria set, joining the two surfaces mechanically; or (b) rule that the ratification review reads the effective criteria set directly (effectiveCriteria, packages/intentionsutil/src/criteria.ts) and amend the liquidation condition to say so, leaving deferredQueue scoped to prose stamps. Choosing between them is an author call about what the deferred queue is for, not an implementation detail.
subject: deferred-authority criteria have no mechanical join to the deferred-disposition queue
